entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who comes to Tarkir seeking his old ally Ugin to stop the Eldrazi, and finds the dragon dead.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The spirit dragon planeswalker who once helped seal the Eldrazi on Zendikar; Sorin finds only his bones and skull in a chasm on Tarkir.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who has also come to Tarkir seeking Ugin.

entities.name: The Lithomancer
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Sorin and Ugin seal the Eldrazi on Zendikar; Sorin is troubled by her silence.

entities.name: Rushka
entities.description: A masked Temur shaman with fire magic who is dominated by Sorin and has his head cut off by his own captain.

entities.name: Temur Guide
entities.description: A Temur warrior whom Sorin enthralls to lead him to Ugin's domain.

entities.name: Temur Captain
entities.description: The leader of a Temur band who leads an attack on Sorin and is drained by a vampire thrall.

entities.name: Temur
entities.description: A clan who revere dragons' memory and say the Spirit Dragon gave them magic to fight the greedy dragons.

entities.name: Sultai
entities.description: A clan the Temur mistake Sorin for, warped by rakshasa magic.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: World-devouring titans who escaped their prison on Zendikar and which only Ugin might stop.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: Ugin's home world, a hot steppe with snow-capped northern mountains where dragons have been hunted to extinction.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Eldrazi were sealed and have now escaped.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Sorin's home world, to which he feels fondness and fears the Eldrazi may come.

entities.name: Markov Manor
entities.description: The manor on Innistrad where Sorin lived as a mortal.

entities.name: Ugin's Chasm
entities.description: An icy canyon of blackened granite in the mountains where Ugin's skeleton lies.

events.summary: Sorin arrives on Tarkir in search of the spirit dragon Ugin, led by an oracle's visions toward a dragon-head mountain peak.
events.quote: Somewhere up there was his destination.

events.summary: Sorin dominates a warrior sentry and drains him dry to feed.
events.quote: drained him to a pale husk.

events.summary: Sorin worries over Nahiri's silence and Ugin's absence while the Eldrazi titans rampage on Zendikar.
events.quote: The Eldrazi titans were a fire that could not be quenched, and Ugin's absence was strange.

events.summary: A Temur band mistakes Sorin for a Sultai demon-spawn and Sorin kills two warriors with death magic and raises them as vampire thralls.
events.quote: Sorin reached out his hand and willed the two leathery corpses back from the dead.

events.summary: Sorin turns Rushka against his captain, who beheads him, and a vampire thrall drains the captain.
events.quote: the captain reacted like a cat and struck the shaman's head off with one blow from his jawbone axe.

events.summary: Sorin dominates a surviving warrior to serve as his guide to Ugin.
The Temur guide tells Sorin that dragons have been hunted to extinction and that the Spirit Dragon gave the Temur magic to fight corrupted dragons.
events.quote: But some say that the dragons became greedy and corrupt, so the Spirit Dragon gave us magic to fight them.

events.summary: The guide leads Sorin to a chasm where only huge bones lie, and Sorin refuses to believe it is Ugin.
Sorin descends into the chasm, finds Ugin's skull in the ice and discovers Ugin is dead.
events.quote: Ugin was dead. And with him fell the hopes of countless worlds.

events.summary: Sorin fears Zendikar and then Innistrad will be consumed and says they are all doomed.

relations.note: Sorin calls Ugin his old ally; they sealed the Eldrazi together with the Lithomancer.
relations.quote: Sorin has found his way here, to Ugin's home world, in search of his old ally.

relations.note: Together with Ugin they sealed the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
relations.quote: Long ago, Sorin helped Ugin and another Planeswalker, the Lithomancer, seal away the monstrous Eldrazi on Zendikar.

relations.note: Sorin hopes Ugin can stop the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: Recently, the Eldrazi escaped, and Sorin believes that Ugin is one of the few who can stop them.

relations.note: Sorin dominates him as a thrall.
Sorin's vampire thrall drains the captain's blood.
relations.quote: the vampire sank its fangs into the captain's spine and drained his blood.
